base: branche de session (arena/01a1024d-projet-pmdo) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Foret Brumeuse (Foggy Forest, D08P11A / P21P02A), choisi par l utilisateur (les 3 layouts)
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip Foggy_Forest_Base_Camp_TDS.png passe au generateur ; decor complet sur magenta (ruisseau = magenta), herbe complete editee depuis le decor, planche feuilles/lucioles sur magenta

reference_da.titre: Foggy Forest Base Camp (D08P11A, PMD Explorers)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same 2D Nintendo DS pixel-art style, palette, and textures as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest Base Camp): same lush medium-green clearing grass with subtle blade texture, same earthy tan dirt path, same dense layered sage-green and lime-highlighted round forest tree canopies, same tall dark-green forest grass border, same coral-pink and orange striped expedition tents with wooden poles, and same small pink/lavender forest flowers and tan stones. Make a NEW, wider top-down 4:3 landscape map (1200x896) of the Foggy Forest Base Camp and surrounding misty clearing: a central grassy camp clearing with three coral-orange expedition tents pitched on the right side, a dirt trail entering from the SOUTH (bottom center), branching through the camp clearing, and continuing to a narrow forest trail exit at the NORTH (top center). On the left side of the clearing, a calm forest stream and small spring pond wind between mossy stones and bushes — IMPORTANT: fill every flat water surface (the stream and pond) with flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF (RGB 255, 0, 255) with crisp pixel edges, no ripples or gradients on the magenta. Dense forest trees frame the left, right, top, and bottom corners. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Edit the first image: keep the exact same 4:3 size (1200x896) and 2D Nintendo DS pixel-art texture from the second reference image (Foggy Forest Base Camp), but remove EVERYTHING except the flat walkable green forest grass ground: no trees, no tents, no bushes, no dirt paths, no rocks, no flowers, no water, no magenta. The entire image must be covered edge-to-edge with seamless medium-bright green forest grass texture with subtle darker green grass blades and tiny clover speckles, uniform lighting across the whole frame.

2D pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF (RGB 255, 0, 255) background, matching the exact pixel-art palette and style of the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest). 2 rows x 6 columns of small isolated sprites with wide pure magenta spacing between every sprite: Row 1 (top row): 6 poses of a single small sage-green and lime-green forest leaf tumbling and fluttering as it falls (tilted left, flat, tilted right, curling, flipping, gentle glide). Row 2 (bottom row): 6 poses of a glowing pale-yellow and misty-cyan forest firefly / mist spore pulsing softly (tiny dim speck, small glow, medium warm yellow-green orb, bright core with soft pixel halo, fading glow, tiny spark). Crisp pixel art, no anti-aliasing against the #FF00FF magenta background, no grid lines, no text, no borders.

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

segmentation: eau = magenta pur + frange dilatee 2 px ; tentes = 3 tentes d expedition rose corail / orange a rayures beiges et mats bois ; chemin = chemin traversant sud->nord + embranchement vers le camp ; herbe = herbe vert olive claire de la clairiere ; fleurs = petits massifs floraux corail/lavande ; rochers = blocs ocre/gris ; buissons = massifs vert sombre dans la clairiere ; arbres = houppiers vert sauge/lime + troncs ; herbes_hautes = sous-bois restant

water.modele: structure et cadence riviere Metano, couleurs Metano EXACTES, sans lisere de rive (water_phases d EWC2)
water.origine: pixels recalcules, pas de tuiles natives

sparkles.origine: pixels et couleurs Metano NATIFS inchanges (aplat de surface retire)

feuilles.origine: dessin GENERE ; trajectoires (chute ~37 px, balancement +/- 6 px) et chronologie creees par nous

lucioles.origine: dessin GENERE ; boucles de Lissajous et pulsation creees par nous

shadows: pas de calque d ombres separe : les zones sombres du rendu sont des houppiers, des buissons ou des herbes hautes

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors herbe de la clairiere, chemin et fleurs
access.camp: coeur de la clairiere devant les trois tentes d expedition
